desc.zh:text: AI 让同样的人、设备与资本产出更多：机器视觉替代重复质检、预测性维护减少停机、大模型压缩知识与文档处理时间，效率提升不再依赖加班加点。
desc.en:text: AI multiplies output from the same people, machines and capital: machine vision replaces repetitive inspection, predictive maintenance cuts downtime, and large models compress knowledge work.

desc.zh:text: 智能驾驶、生成式内容、具身智能、AI 制药……AI 本身成为巨大的产业，同时把旧行业重新组装成新赛道，创造出过去不存在的岗位与市场。
desc.en:text: Autonomous driving, generative content, embodied intelligence, AI drug discovery — AI is itself a huge industry that reassembles old sectors into brand-new markets and jobs.

desc.zh:text: 数据成为可复用的生产要素，算力像水电一样按需调度；AI 让供需预测更准、库存更薄、物流更短，把资源从「平均用力」转向「精准投放」。
desc.en:text: Data becomes a reusable factor and compute is dispatched on demand like utilities. Better forecasting means thinner inventory and shorter logistics — from average allocation to precision allocation.

desc.zh:text: 电网用 AI 调度削峰填谷、数据中心液冷降耗、工业用 AI 优化能耗曲线；单位 GDP 的能耗与排放正在被算法一点点「抠」下来。
desc.en:text: AI balances power grids, liquid cooling lowers data-centre energy use, and algorithms flatten industrial energy curves — energy and emissions per unit of GDP keep falling.

desc.zh:text: AI 把重复劳动交还机器，把创造力、判断力与情感连接还给人；优质医疗、教育与政务资源通过 AI 下沉到县域与乡村，让发展成果更可及。
desc.en:text: AI hands repetitive work to machines and gives creativity, judgement and empathy back to people; quality healthcare, education and public services reach smaller counties and villages.
